title: AI Is About to Become the New Polyester #AI #ArtificialIntelligence
description:
AI might be heading toward the same fate as polyester.

Polyester started as an innovative material with useful properties. But as it became cheap, scalable, and everywhere, it became closely associated with mass-produced fast fashion.

AI could follow a surprisingly similar path.

Right now, knowing how to use AI can feel like a major advantage. But what happens when everyone can use AI to write, design, code, create videos, build products, and generate content?

The advantage disappears.

When AI-generated work becomes abundant, simply using AI may no longer make your work valuable. In fact, it could eventually make certain types of work feel less distinctive.

And that’s where the real shift happens.

The scarce resource may not be AI anymore.

It could be human taste, judgment, originality, experience, and knowing when NOT to use AI.

The future may not belong to people who use the most AI. It could belong to people who know where AI adds value and where human involvement matters more.
